Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<numeric>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    bool canPartition(vector<int>& nums) {
        int sum = accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0);
        if (sum % 2 != 0) return false;
        vector<int> dp(sum + 1, 0); // dp[i]: 类似于0-1背包问题, 存0或1, 子序列的和能达到i就记作1, 否则记为0
        dp[0] = 1;
        for (const int& num : nums)
        {
            for (int i = sum; i >= 0; i--)
                if (dp[i] == 1) dp[i + num] = 1;
            if (dp[sum/2] == 1) return true;   // 如果其中一组的和为 sum/2, 那么就返回true
        }
        return false;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {1, 5, 11, 5};
    auto res = sol.canPartition(nums);
    cout << (res ? "True" : "False") << endl;

    return 0;
}
